text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that an all-way stop control be authorized at the intersection of Lord Roberts Drive and Wainfleet Road as the existing conditions meet the warrant for the installation of such a traffic control device. This location currently has stop control facing the northbound approach on Wainfleet Road.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Lord Roberts Drive and Wainfleet Road.
